data.body: AC amendment (gap finding 6 - change-detector litmus): Ensure at least one assertion ties to observable behavior across multiple semantic requirements: assert that the gate text references (a) prior turns / semantic check language AND (b) at least one codebase tool name (Grep|Read|Glob) AND (c) all 3 probe IDs from ux-probe-set.md. A rewording that removes any of these three is a substantive change that should fail the test; a cosmetic rewording that preserves all three should still pass.
